title: Module path cannot be resolved by any proxy
description: go.mod declares a module path with no domain component. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a module path with no domain component.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a module path with no domain component.
limitation: It matches a module path with no domain component in the parsed go.mod; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
